<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="changelog-rendering">
<h1>Changelog rendering</h1>
<section id="two-step-model">
<h2>Two-step model</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">changelog</span></code> renders review context. Use it when a human or
coding agent needs release metadata, entries, target-file guidance, and optional
lint findings. Pass <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--include-sources</span></code> to include provenance refs in Markdown
output.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span></code> renders the final changelog section and inserts it into
the target file. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--dry-run</span></code> before writing and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--replace-existing</span></code> when
re-rendering an existing release section. Pass <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--template</span> <span class="pre">NAME</span></code> to select a
named changelog template profile.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build</span></code> never invents entries from git commits. Git commit ranges require
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">git</span> <span class="pre">scaffold</span></code> / audit / entry curation before a strict build can pass.</p>
</section>
<section id="full-changelog-rebuild">
<h2>Full changelog rebuild</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span></code> with no <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">VERSION</span></code> (or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span> <span class="pre">--all</span></code>)
rebuilds the <strong>complete</strong> target file from ledger state:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span> <span class="pre">VERSION</span></code> updates one release section.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span> <span class="pre">--all</span></code> rebuilds the whole
target file from ledger state.</p></li>
<li><p>Full rebuild excludes internal entries and non-released releases by default.</p></li>
<li><p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--include-internal</span></code> only for internal release notes.</p></li>
<li><p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--include-release-status</span></code> to include candidate/planned sections
explicitly.</p></li>
<li><p>Full rebuild preserves the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">##</span> <span class="pre">[Unreleased]</span></code> body by default
(<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-preserve-unreleased</span></code> clears it) and is a whole-file rewrite (no
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--replace-existing</span></code>).</p></li>
<li><p>An <strong>empty</strong> <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">##</span> <span class="pre">[Unreleased]</span></code> section is omitted: the heading (and its
link reference) is rendered only when an unreleased body exists.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--unreleased-version</span> <span class="pre">VERSION</span></code> folds a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planned</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">draft</span></code>/<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">candidate</span></code>
release’s accepted entries into the canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">##</span> <span class="pre">[Unreleased]</span></code> section
without a version heading, and excludes that release from the normal release
sections. It is rejected for a missing, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">canceled</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">yanked</span></code>, or already
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">released</span></code> version, and is valid only for full builds.</p></li>
<li><p>Generated folded Unreleased content is automatically removed once the folded
release is finalized.</p></li>
<li><p>Manual Unreleased content (without <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;!--</span> <span class="pre">releaseledger:unreleased-start</span></code>
markers) is always preserved by default.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="group-modes">
<h2>Group modes</h2>
<p>Entry kinds are grouped for rendering. The mode is set by
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">changelog_group_mode</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[changelog]</span></code>.</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">keepachangelog</span></code> (Keep a Changelog 1.1.0) renders exactly six groups in
order: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Added</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Changed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Deprecated</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Removed</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Fixed</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Security</span></code>. Extended kinds map onto these groups:</p>
<ul>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs</span> <span class="pre">-&gt;</span> <span class="pre">changed</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">quality</span> <span class="pre">-&gt;</span> <span class="pre">changed</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">internal</span> <span class="pre">-&gt;</span> <span class="pre">changed</span></code> (hidden unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--include-internal</span></code>)</p></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">extended</span></code> (the default) renders <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Documentation</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Quality</span></code>, and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Internal</span></code> as their own groups alongside the Keep a Changelog groups.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="default-template">
<h2>Default template</h2>
<p>The default <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.releaseledger.toml</span></code> contains:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">[changelog]</span>
<span class="n">output</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;CHANGELOG.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">trim</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">render_always</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span>
<span class="n">header</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="n">body</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="s2">## {% if release.date %}[{{ release.version }}] - {{ release.date }}{% else %}[{{ release.version }}] - Unreleased{% endif %}</span>

<span class="s2">{% for group in groups %}</span>
<span class="s2">### {{ group.title }}</span>
<span class="s2">{% for entry in group.entries %}</span>
<span class="s2">- {% if entry.breaking %}**BREAKING:** {% endif %}{{ entry.summary }}</span>
<span class="s2">{% endfor %}</span>

<span class="s2">{% endfor %}</span>
<span class="s2">&quot;&quot;&quot;</span>
<span class="n">footer</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;!-- generated by releaseledger --&gt;&quot;</span>
<span class="n">postprocessors</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="template-context">
<h2>Template context</h2>
<p>Templates run in a sandboxed Jinja2 environment and may access:</p>
<dl class="simple myst">
<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">project</span></code></dt><dd><p>Project or ledger name.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span></code></dt><dd><p>The target release payload, including <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code> and effective <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">date</span></code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">entries</span></code></dt><dd><p>Included entry payloads.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">groups</span></code></dt><dd><p>Entries grouped by changelog title.</p>
</dd>
<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releases</span></code></dt><dd><p>Known release payloads.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</section>
<section id="postprocessors">
<h2>Postprocessors</h2>
<p>Postprocessors apply literal string replacements after template rendering:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">postprocessors</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">pattern</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;releaseledger&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">replace</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Releaseledger&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="strict-builds">
<h2>Strict builds</h2>
<p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">VERSION</span> <span class="pre">--strict</span> <span class="pre">--target-file</span> <span class="pre">CHANGELOG.md</span></code>
before a final public build.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">build</span> <span class="pre">--strict</span></code> blocks on entry lint errors, empty included
entries unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-empty</span></code> is supplied, release source refs that are
not covered by included entries, and (for releases with stored git range
metadata) git commits that have no accepted entry coverage. Internal-only
entries satisfy audit coverage but are reported as excluded from the
public changelog. A dated <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">planned</span></code> release is also a strict-state failure for
the final public workflow.</p>
</section>
<section id="release-review">
<h2>Release review</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">review</span> <span class="pre">VERSION</span></code> is a read-only coverage report. It combines
release state, entry coverage, orphan detection, entry lint, and a strict
changelog dry-run into one deterministic report so agents and humans do not
need to run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">show</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">entry</span> <span class="pre">list</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">entry</span> <span class="pre">lint</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">changelog</span></code>,
and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build</span> <span class="pre">--dry-run</span></code> separately.</p>
<p>Each expected source ref (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release.source_refs</span></code> plus <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">boundary_ref</span></code>) is
classified as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">covered</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">draft_only</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rejected_only</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">internal_only</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">missing</span></code>. Accepted entries with no provenance
(empty <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_refs</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">issues</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prs</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sources</span></code>) are reported as
orphans. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--strict</span></code> exits non-zero when the release is not OK.</p>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">releaseledger</span> <span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">VERSION</span> <span class="pre">--strict</span> <span class="pre">--target-file</span> <span class="pre">CHANGELOG.md</span></code>
as the final consolidated gate immediately before writing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">CHANGELOG.md</span></code>.</p>
<p>Run review before adding a new entry. If the same <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_ref</span></code> is already
covered by an accepted entry, update the existing entry instead of adding a
duplicate.</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger review 0.5.0
releaseledger --json review 0.5.0
releaseledger review 0.5.0 --strict --target-file CHANGELOG.md
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="section-correction">
<h2>Section correction</h2>
<p>When a release section in the target changelog is stale (wrong version number
or a canceled release), correct it with the section helpers rather than editing
the file by hand:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>releaseledger changelog-section rename-section OLD NEW --target-file CHANGELOG.md
releaseledger changelog-section remove-section VERSION --target-file CHANGELOG.md
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">rename</span> <span class="pre">--rename-changelog-section</span></code> and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span> <span class="pre">cancel</span> <span class="pre">--remove-changelog-section</span></code> apply the same corrections as part
of a release correction. Both fail when the source section is missing unless
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--ignore-missing</span></code> is passed, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rename-section</span></code> fails when the
destination section already exists unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--replace-existing</span></code> is passed.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>

      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
